name: Mangrove Lagoon
description: Your fishing journey begins in these calm, root-tangled waters. It is the perfect nursery ground for a novice angler to learn the ropes.

name: The Grand Horizon
description: The shoreline fades completely out of sight in this massive, open-water expanse. A diverse paradise of mid-tier game fish awaits those brave enough to sail here.

name: Absolute Zero
description: A brutal, ice-locked wasteland where the water itself defies freezing. Only the hardiest anglers can survive to pull legendary, frost-adapted species from beneath the ice shelves.

name: The Deep Abyss
description: Pitch-black waters plunging into the planet's lowest depths. This crushing, alien environment holds the ultimate prize: colossal, bioluminescent game fish sought by masters.
